brief.brief_text: Rivermouth (4-3-3) press from a mid shape, mix short and long and hold a mid line. Ashford Vale (4-3-3) press from a mid shape, mix short and long and sit in a mid shape. A goalless first half, then a red card on the hour flips the game.

storyline.text: A goalless first half, then a red card on the hour flips the game.

claims.text: Ashford win the ball 7 metres out and Bellamy-Cruz fires a blocked 0.30 xG shot after 4 seconds.
Rivermouth are pressing hard in Ashford's half, keeping 61 per cent of the ball and firing four shots in this spell.
claims.draft_text: Rivermouth are camped in Ashford's half, enjoying 61% of the ball and firing four shots in this spell.
claims.reason: Judge (overclaim): 'pressing hard in Ashford's half' asserts territorial pressure/positioning not stated by the possession and shots facts.

claims.text: Okafor-Lind is shown a second yellow and is sent off.
Ashford Vale have dropped 9 metres deeper since the red card and are defending in a tighter 730 square metres shape.
Rivermouth lead 1–0 and have dropped their back line 6 metres since the goal, while Ashford's share of play has risen to 53%.
claims.draft_text: Rivermouth lead 1–0 and have dropped their back line 6 metres since the goal, giving Ashford more of the ball in the final third.
claims.reason: Judge (overclaim): Saying Ashford have "more of the ball in the final third" is a comparative claim not supported by the single percent figure given (53% share) which doesn't by itself prove 'more' in the final third.

claims.text: Pryce scores for Rivermouth after a 16 s build-up that began 73 metres out; Rivermouth lead.
claims.draft_text: Pryce scores for Rivermouth, a tidy finish after a 16 s move that started 73 metres out, Rivermouth lead.
claims.reason: Voice rule evaluative-adjective broken by "tidy": A judgement the data cannot support; say what happened.

claims.text: Rivermouth lead 2–0 and Ashford Vale have pushed their back line 4 metres higher since the goal, leaving more space across the pitch.
Pryce scores for Rivermouth, a smart finish after a 6-second move to make it 2–0.
The shot carried 0.14 xG and found the net despite four defenders around the box.
